## Labs

- [`Session_01.ipynb`](labs/Session_01.ipynb) — Image Representation.
- [`Session_02.ipynb`](labs/Session_02.ipynb) — Point Operations.
- [`Session_03.ipynb`](labs/Session_03.ipynb) — Gray-level Transformation.
- [`Session_04.ipynb`](labs/Session_04.ipynb) — Histogram and Histogram Equalization.
- [`Session_05.ipynb`](labs/Session_05.ipynb) — Image Restoration.
- [`Session_06.ipynb`](labs/Session_06.ipynb) — Image Restoration (Sharpening) and Morphology.
- [`Session_07.ipynb`](labs/Session_07.ipynb) — Image Segmentation.
- [`Session_08.ipynb`](labs/Session_08.ipynb) — Edge Detection.
- [`Session_09.ipynb`](labs/Session_09.ipynb) — Key-point Detection.
